name: broken-links-auditor
title: Broken Links Auditor
description: Crawl a site and report every broken internal or external link with HTTP status, source page and anchor text. Site-health audits that used to need desktop tooling now run on a schedule.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Broken Links Auditor
input.description: Crawl a site and report every broken internal or external link with HTTP status, source page and anchor text. Site-health audits that used to need desktop tooling now run on a schedule.

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Hard cap on processed pages (runaway protection).

check_externals.title: Check external links
check_externals.description: Also verify links leaving the domain.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
